description: Use your brain , its the most radical thing you can do 🥂 #criticalthinking #radicalacceptance #fyp #LifeByDesign
transcript: The most radical thing that we can do is wake up. It is so easy to stay in these mundane routines and just sit in autopilot while our lives are moving past us. The thing that we can do is turn our brains on and use them and move away from emotions, move away from others thoughts and opinions and really take full control of our lives by using the research that we already have.
